lines.speaker: 爱德华
lines.pinyin: Shānběn, nǐ de gǎnmào hǎo le ma?
lines.en: Yamamoto, is your cold better?

lines.speaker: 山本
lines.zh: 好了。来中国以后我已经得过三次感冒了。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo le. Lái Zhōngguó yǐhòu wǒ yǐjīng déguo sān cì gǎnmào le.
lines.en: Yes. Since coming to China I’ve already had three colds.

lines.speaker: 爱德华
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yí cì bìng yě méiyǒu déguo.
lines.en: I haven’t been sick even once.

lines.speaker: 山本
lines.zh: 你身体真不错。我还住过一次院呢，看过中医，也吃过中药。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shēntǐ zhēn búcuò. Wǒ hái zhùguo yí cì yuàn ne, kànguo Zhōngyī, yě chīguo Zhōngyào.
lines.en: You’re really healthy. I’ve even been hospitalized, seen a TCM doctor, and taken Chinese medicine.

lines.speaker: 爱德华
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō Zhōngyào hěn kǔ, shì ma?
lines.en: I hear Chinese medicine is bitter — is that true?

lines.speaker: 山本
lines.zh: 有的苦，有的不苦。我喝的是中成药，甜甜的，一点儿也不苦。吃了这些中药，我的病就好了。
lines.pinyin: Yǒude kǔ, yǒude bù kǔ. Wǒ hē de shì Zhōngchéngyào, tiántián de, yìdiǎnr yě bù kǔ. Chī le zhèxiē Zhōngyào, wǒ de bìng jiù hǎo le.
lines.en: Some are, some aren’t. Mine was patent medicine — sweet, not bitter at all. After it I got better.

lines.speaker: 爱德华
lines.zh: 我听说中医看病很有意思。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ tīngshuō Zhōngyī kàn bìng hěn yǒu yìsi.
lines.en: I hear TCM consultations are interesting.

lines.speaker: 山本
lines.zh: 中医看病不化验，只用手摸一摸脉就给你开药方。还用按摩、针灸等方法给病人治病。
lines.pinyin: Zhōngyī kàn bìng bù huàyàn, zhǐ yòng shǒu mōyimo mài jiù gěi nǐ kāi yàofāng. Hái yòng ànmó, zhēnjiǔ děng fāngfǎ gěi bìngrén zhì bìng.
lines.en: No lab tests — just feel the pulse and write a prescription. Also massage, acupuncture, and so on.

lines.speaker: 爱德华
lines.pinyin: Shì dǎ zhēn ma?
lines.en: Is that an injection?

lines.speaker: 山本
lines.pinyin: Bú shì dǎ zhēn, shì zhā zhēn.
lines.en: Not an injection — acupuncture needling.

lines.speaker: 爱德华
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zhēnjiǔ guo ma?
lines.en: Have you had acupuncture?

lines.speaker: 山本
lines.zh: 我做过按摩，没针灸过，但是见过。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuòguo ànmó, méi zhēnjiǔ guo, dànshì jiànguo.
lines.en: I’ve had massage, not acupuncture, but I’ve seen it.

lines.speaker: 爱德华
lines.pinyin: Shì shénme yàng de zhēn ne?
lines.en: What kind of needles?

lines.speaker: 山本
lines.pinyin: Shì yì zhǒng hěn xì hěn xì de zhēn.
lines.en: Very thin needles.

lines.speaker: 爱德华
lines.pinyin: Méi jiànguo.
lines.en: Never seen them.

dialogues.label: 课文（二）
dialogues.headingEn: Have you been to China before?

lines.speaker: 罗兰
lines.zh: 山本，听说你曾经来过中国，是吗？
lines.pinyin: Shānběn, tīngshuō nǐ céngjīng láiguo Zhōngguó, shì ma?
lines.en: Yamamoto, I hear you’ve been to China before — true?

lines.speaker: 山本
lines.pinyin: Shì a, láiguo yí cì. Nǐ ne?
lines.en: Yes, once. You?

lines.speaker: 罗兰
lines.zh: 我没有来过，这是第一次。你都去过什么地方？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu láiguo, zhè shì dì yí cì. Nǐ dōu qùguo shénme dìfang?
lines.en: Never — this is my first time. Where have you been?

lines.speaker: 山本
lines.zh: 我已经去过好多地方了。北边去过哈尔滨，南边到过海南岛，东边上过泰山，西边去过西安和敦煌。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng qùguo hǎo duō dìfang le. Běibian qùguo Hā'ěrbīn, nánbian dàoguo Hǎinán Dǎo, dōngbian shàngguo Tài Shān, xībian qùguo Xī'ān hé Dūnhuáng.
lines.en: Lots of places — Harbin north, Hainan south, Mount Tai east, Xi’an and Dunhuang west.

lines.speaker: 罗兰
lines.zh: 你去过的地方真不少。来中国以后，我只去过颐和园、故宫和长城。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ qùguo de dìfang zhēn bù shǎo. Lái Zhōngguó yǐhòu, wǒ zhǐ qùguo Yíhé Yuán, Gùgōng hé Chángchéng.
lines.en: That’s a lot. Since arriving I’ve only done Summer Palace, Forbidden City, Great Wall.

lines.speaker: 山本
lines.pinyin: Xíguàn chī Zhōngcān le ma?
lines.en: Used to Chinese food?

lines.speaker: 罗兰
lines.pinyin: Zǎo jiù xíguàn le.
lines.en: Long ago.

lines.speaker: 山本
lines.pinyin: Nǐ chīguo nǎxiē Zhōngguó cài?
lines.en: Which Chinese dishes have you tried?

lines.speaker: 罗兰
lines.zh: 吃过很多。最喜欢吃的是北京烤鸭。你爱吃什么？
lines.pinyin: Chīguo hěn duō. Zuì xǐhuan chī de shì Běijīng kǎoyā. Nǐ ài chī shénme?
lines.en: Many. Favorite is Beijing roast duck. You?

lines.speaker: 山本
lines.zh: 中国菜我都爱吃。还爱吃烤白薯、糖葫芦什么的。
lines.pinyin: Zhōngguó cài wǒ dōu ài chī. Hái ài chī kǎo báishǔ, tánghúlu shénme de.
lines.en: I love all Chinese food — also roasted sweet potato, candied haws, etc.

lines.speaker: 罗兰
lines.pinyin: Kànguo Jīngjù ma?
lines.en: Seen Peking Opera?

lines.speaker: 山本
lines.zh: 没看过。听说京剧很有意思，我很想去看看。
lines.pinyin: Méi kànguo. Tīngshuō Jīngjù hěn yǒu yìsi, wǒ hěn xiǎng qù kànkan.
lines.en: Not yet. I hear it’s interesting — I’d love to go.

dialogues.label: 课文（三）
dialogues.headingZh: 我听过钢琴协奏曲《黄河》
dialogues.headingEn: I've heard the piano concerto Yellow River

lines.speaker: 田芳
lines.zh: 爱德华，你说你是个音乐迷，你听过中国音乐吗？
lines.pinyin: Àidéhuá, nǐ shuō nǐ shì ge yīnyuè mí, nǐ tīngguo Zhōngguó yīnyuè ma?
lines.en: Edward, you say you’re a music fan — heard Chinese music?

lines.speaker: 爱德华
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán tīngguo!
lines.en: Of course!

lines.speaker: 田芳
lines.pinyin: Tīngguo shénme?
lines.en: What?

lines.speaker: 爱德华
lines.zh: 在加拿大时，我亲耳听过一位中国钢琴家演奏的《黄河》。
lines.pinyin: Zài Jiānádà shí, wǒ qīn'ěr tīngguo yí wèi Zhōngguó gāngqínjiā yǎnzòu de 《Huáng Hé》.
lines.en: In Canada I personally heard a Chinese pianist play Yellow River.

lines.speaker: 田芳
lines.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: What did you think?

lines.speaker: 爱德华
lines.pinyin: Hǎo jí le, zhēn xiǎng zài tīng yí biàn.
lines.en: Wonderful — I’d love to hear it again.

lines.speaker: 田芳
lines.zh: 听过小提琴协奏曲《梁祝》吗？
lines.pinyin: Tīngguo xiǎotíqín xiézòuqǔ 《Liáng Zhù》 ma?
lines.en: Heard Butterfly Lovers?

lines.speaker: 爱德华
lines.zh: 听说过，但是没听过。好听吗？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō guo, dànshì méi tīngguo. Hǎotīng ma?
lines.en: Heard of it, not heard it. Good?

lines.speaker: 田芳
lines.pinyin: Nǐ tīng le jiù zhīdào le.
lines.en: You’ll know when you hear it.

lines.speaker: 爱德华
lines.zh: 我很想听听，你这儿有吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xiǎng tīngting, nǐ zhèr yǒu ma?
lines.en: I’d love to — do you have it?

lines.speaker: 田芳
lines.pinyin: Yǒu. Wǒ zhège yōupán li jiù yǒu.
lines.en: Yes — on this USB.

lines.speaker: 爱德华
lines.pinyin: Jiè gěi wǒ tīngting ba.
lines.en: Lend it to me?

lines.speaker: 田芳
lines.zh: 你拿去吧。听完就还给我。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ náqù ba. Tīngwán jiù huán gěi wǒ.
lines.en: Take it. Return it after.

lines.speaker: 爱德华
lines.zh: 一定。“好借好还，再借不难”嘛。
lines.pinyin: Yídìng. “Hǎo jiè hǎo huán, zài jiè bù nán” ma.
lines.en: Sure. ‘Return what you borrow and borrowing again is easy.’

notes.title: 我一次病也没有得过。
notes.body: “一…也／都＋没／不…”表示完全否定。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: Wǒ yí cì bìng yě méiyǒu déguo.
example.en: I haven’t been sick even once.

notes.title: “好借好还，再借不难”嘛。
notes.body: 谚语。别人借给你的东西要及时还，以后再借就不难。“嘛”用在句末强调肯定、理应如此。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: “Hǎo jiè hǎo huán, zài jiè bù nán” ma.
example.en: ‘Return what you borrow and borrowing again is easy.’

notes.title: 《黄河》
notes.body: 《黄河》是根据《黄河大合唱》改编的钢琴协奏曲，中国音乐经典之作。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.zh: 我亲耳听过一位中国钢琴家演奏的《黄河》。
example.pinyin: Wǒ qīn'ěr tīngguo yí wèi Zhōngguó gāngqínjiā yǎnzòu de 《Huáng Hé》.
example.en: I personally heard a Chinese pianist play Yellow River.

notes.title: ……极了
notes.body: “极了”放在形容词和一些动词后边，表示最高的程度。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

notes.title: 《梁祝》
notes.body: 全称《梁山伯与祝英台》，何占豪、陈钢创作的著名小提琴协奏曲。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.zh: 听过小提琴协奏曲《梁祝》吗？

notes.title: 动词＋过
notes.body: 动词后动态助词“过”表示过去经历；动作一般不持续，强调曾经有过的经验。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.en: Have you been to China before?

notes.title: 动量补语
notes.body: 表示动作次数用动量补语（如一次、一遍）。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

notes.title: 序数的表达
notes.body: 用“第＋数词”表示序数（第一次）。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.
